source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

original_test_intent: Verify that approved BMC network values entered through BIOS persist across save/reboot and return to SPEC defaults without creating an address conflict, crossing an unintended management boundary, or losing every path to the controller.
original_method: On an isolated management network, manually change bounded BMC network fields in BIOS, save/reboot and verify persistence/reconnect; then Load Default, save/reboot, compare with SPEC and restore the approved final network configuration.
manual_activity: A human must enter exact BMC network values in the pre-OS interface, handle the expected session loss, complete save/default phases and visually verify fields. Agent reachability and protocol checks are supporting evidence only.
required_inputs: Board/BIOS/BMC identity and dedicated/shared interface mapping
Isolated test VLAN/subnet, reserved addresses and allowed routes
Approved DHCP/static, IPv4/IPv6, mask/prefix, gateway, VLAN and service values plus SPEC defaults
Independent local/serial console and BMC reset/recovery path
Expected activation timing and reconnect endpoint
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or use an unreserved production address.
Validate address, prefix/mask, gateway, VLAN and interface ownership before applying any value.
Keep a recovery console independent of the BMC interface being changed; do not rely on the active session.
Stop on address conflict, unintended routability/service exposure, link loss, duplicate IP, BMC fault or loss of all recovery paths.
Do not place secrets or credentials in evidence.
agent_execution_scope: Collect redacted read-only BMC network configuration, link, address, route/VLAN context, allowed-service reachability, logs and host health.
Correlate reconnect timing and endpoint with the approved topology.
Do not drive BIOS, assign addresses, change firewall/routing policy or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the field/value/default/topology matrix and independent recovery.
Perform and capture persistence, reconnect, Load Default and final restoration.
Assess isolation/reachability/security evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent BIOS editing. No source command exists; remote BMC API configuration would change the interface by another path and is not equivalent to testing BIOS persistence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the firmware path and use only approved read-only link/address/reachability checks after each operator transition. Do not substitute host NIC configuration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source persistence/default lifecycle, null script and 5/20-minute fields are retained; all/random is preserved only as non-executable source text.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Reserve every address, document dedicated/shared port and VLAN/routing boundaries, predefine reconnect endpoints and timeouts, then capture exact BIOS values plus independent reachability/service exposure through persistence, defaults and final restoration.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BIOS/BMC revision, management-interface wiring and approved isolated network.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS, BMC, management protocols/clients and network-test tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform BMC network configuration and reset/activation documentation plus project network policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces random network mutation with conflict-free, isolated and recoverable transitions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; preserves persistence/default checks and adds endpoint, isolation and exposure verification.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Topology, reservations, field matrix, activation and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Ping alone is insufficient; protocol availability, interface identity and unintended exposure must be assessed without credential disclosure.

project_override_considerations: A project may test a selected DHCP/static or IPv4/IPv6 matrix. Completion is limited to those endpoints/VLANs and must not claim untested routing, shared-port or service-exposure behavior.
expected_evidence: Platform/interface topology, reservations, field/default matrix, approval and recovery
Redacted baseline BMC network, link, route/VLAN and service-reachability state
Non-default captures, save/reboot, activation and exact reconnect evidence
Load Default, SPEC comparison and safe default reconnect
Final approved configuration, logs, exposure check and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The field-persistence and default-restoration lifecycle is coherent for BMC network controls. Missing addresses and topology are project inputs, not opposing requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intended BMC network lifecycle is clear. Exact values, isolation and an independent console are mandatory readiness gates but do not make the case intrinsically blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees on manual operation and adds network conflict/exposure/reconnect controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its isolated-network and recovery evidence but corrects classification to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates agent reachability checks from core firmware execution and defines persistent endpoint identity and credential-redaction boundaries.

review_improvement: Transforms an unsafe random network change into a reserved, isolated transition plan with proof of both intended reachability and absence of unintended exposure.
independent_technical_reasoning: Network evidence can be automated only after the engineer changes the firmware and manages connection loss. Those manual operations and visual value checks are the core test, so MANUAL ONLY applies.
no_automatic_retry: Do not automatically reapply network values, reset the BMC or repeat reboots after conflict or reachability failure; preserve first evidence and use the approved recovery decision.
